fields.summary_ko.0: Founders Fund and Peter Thiel reduced their SpaceX (SPCX) stake by approximately 26% last quarter, selling approximately $1.7 billion worth of stock, with the reduction estimated to be a proportional distribution to investors.
fields.summary_ko.1: As of September 30, Founders Fund's total stake decreased to 314,357,058 shares (3.8% of 824 million shares), down 26.4% from 427,306,025 shares (5.5%) as of June 30.
